highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.159.0 Preview 1 brings Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements.
highlights_body: The native update also includes image and rendering correctness fixes. WebAssembly consumers now require .NET 9 or later; non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged.

breaking.title: Upgrade WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later
breaking.body: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp retire .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets and reject unsupported WASM frameworks before building. Retarget browser applications to .NET 9 or later: .NET 9/10 uses Emscripten 3.1.56 archives and .NET 11+ uses 6.0.2. Newer archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Adds WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements and image/rendering correctness fixes without changing C API exports or public managed signatures. HarfBuzzSharp's 15.0.0.100 milestone revision continues to bundle HarfBuzz 15.0.0.

preview_summaries.v4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22: Introduces Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. Browser native assets require .NET 9 or later, while HarfBuzzSharp's 15.0.0.100 revision retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and the same public API. Its WebAssembly assets now require .NET 9 or later, selecting runtime-matched archives for .NET 9/10 and .NET 11+; non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.
